card.name: Mid-sentence points in dosing text
card.fires_on: Fires on the word 'the' after 'hepatic impairment,' and on partway-through pieces of drug and enzyme names such as CYP3A4, lamivudine and thrombocytopenia. Also fires on numbers inside interaction results.
